name: King Alone
storyline: Betrayed by his own kingdom, the King flees with everything he has left: a cart loaded with his last belongings and his blinded Queen riding on top. Hunted by knights, war hounds and dark cults, he must lead the caravan along the Harvest Road, through the poisoned Venom Marches where the dead rise, and across the Frozen Pass. Along the way he recruits pikemen, longbowmen and freed prisoners to defend the cart. Each day on the road is another battle, and as long as the Queen lives, there is still hope for the crown.
summary:
King Alone is a tower defense and action strategy game where players take on the role of a King fleeing a kingdom that has turned against him. With his Queen blinded by their enemies, the King must protect her while traveling through dangerous lands in a constantly moving caravan.

Instead of defending a stationary base, players build and upgrade a caravan of specialized war carts, recruit soldiers, manage resources, and fight alongside their army against waves of enemies and siege engines.
